detail.longDescription: "API keys will require Last.fm Pro from 1st December" Oh well, time to move on after at least 15(!) years from trusty Last.fm to a self-hosted Koito ( https://koito.io ) instance after exporting everything with https://lastfm.ghan.nl/export/ . Yeah, the pro subscription hadn't any useful features for me yet, but 5 EUR/month just to have an API access to data I created in the first place is a bit of an ask. # selfhosted # ownyourdata # indieweb
